title: cyperus tanganyicanus
intro: Cyperus tanganyicanus, commonly known as Kukune, is a plant species that belongs to the Cyperaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Kukune include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Cyperus tanganyicanus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
